name: FCR (Fludarabine + Cyclophosphamide + Rituximab)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care dosing (experimental; owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Rituximab infusion-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: antihistamine, antipyretic and (per practice) a corticosteroid before the infusion.

premedications.name: Tumor-lysis-syndrome prophylaxis
premedications.notes: hydration and allopurinol for higher tumor burden.

supportiveCare: Chemoimmunotherapy reserved for fit, TP53 wild-type, IGHV-mutated patients; never use with del(17p)/TP53 mutation.
PJP and herpesvirus (VZV/HSV) prophylaxis throughout and after therapy (purine-analog T-cell suppression).
Irradiate cellular blood products (purine-analog transfusion-associated graft-versus-host risk).
Hepatitis B reactivation prophylaxis if HBcAb-positive (anti-CD20 antibody).
Counsel on cytopenias, infection, and a small risk of therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle and during cytopenias
renal function before each cycle (fludarabine and cyclophosphamide renal clearance)
consider G-CSF support per febrile-neutropenia risk

doseModificationRules.condition: CrCl below about 70 mL/min, or grade 3 to 4 cytopenia
doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold fludarabine and cyclophosphamide for renal impairment or significant cytopenia; avoid fludarabine at very low clearance; physician decides.

drugs.name: Fludarabine
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 to 3 of a 28-day cycle for 6 cycles. An oral formulation at a higher mg/m2 is an alternative. Reduce for renal impairment. Own wording; not copied from any source.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 250 mg/m2 IV on days 1 to 3 of a 28-day cycle for 6 cycles. Own wording; not copied from any source.

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of cycle 1, then 500 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of cycles 2 through 6. dosePerUnit is the first-cycle 375 mg/m2 dose; the 500 mg/m2 escalation from cycle 2 is noted here. Own wording; not copied from any source.
